# LLMTRANSPORT-01 baseline (docs/inventory/llm-transport.md).
# "<file> | <func> | <what> | <count> | <reason>". Every name check outside the
# adapters is listed; the list only shrinks. A new entry needs the owner's approval.
# "permanent:" entries stay (decoders, display names, URL/MCP schemes, path
# conventions); every other entry names the task that removes it.
